title: Carmel Event March 15
content: Join me in Carmel, CA on Saturday, March 15 from 12:00-2:00 for a presentation and book signing.I'll be talking about my friendship with Tom Kinkade and how it led to the book "The Artist's Guide to Sketching."This will be the only public event in the Bay Area for this book (the other events are at art schools and animation studios), and the first time I've done an event at aThomas Kinkade gallery,which should be an interesting experience for all of us.
